Description: Adds a one-click Preview button to media cards in the Umbraco media library. It opens the media item's standard editor as a fly-out, so editors can view images and play video or audio without leaving the media section. Each file's menu also gains Copy URL.

Screenshots.Caption: Hover over a media card and click the eye to preview it
The eye sits next to the "..." menu on every file in the media library
Videos play in the fly-out without leaving the media library
Images open in the same fly-out
Audio plays with Umbraco's built-in player
Copy a file's URL from the "..." menu

Title: SA.Umbraco.MediaPreview
